name: Amazon Smart Thermostat (US)

matter.note: No Amazon or Ring page claims Matter, and the CSA listings found for 'Smart Thermostat' belong to Tuya and Meross. Absence is not a no.

apple_home.note: No Amazon or Ring page mentions Apple Home, and no Matter certification was found.

google_home.note: No Amazon or Ring page mentions Google Home, and no Matter certification was found.

alexa.note: Set up in the Alexa app; voice control needs an Alexa-enabled device. It also works with the Ring app.

home_assistant.note: No official Home Assistant integration for this thermostat was found.

hubRequired.note: It joins 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and is set up in the Alexa app, but neither Amazon nor Ring says outright that no hub or Echo is needed. Voice control needs an Alexa-enabled device.

localControl.note: Amazon does not state what works without internet.

systems.value: Most 24 V HVAC, incl. heat pumps
systems.note: Covers forced air, heat pump and radiant boiler setups on 24 V. Not compatible with 110-240 V systems such as electric baseboard heat.

power.note: Ring says it may need a C-wire or a power adapter kit, sold separately, and that most homes have a C-wire. Standby draw is 0.89 W.

summary: Built for Alexa, the Amazon Smart Thermostat (S6ED3R) is set up in the Alexa app over 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and also works with the Ring app. This US wall thermostat covers most 24 V systems, including heat pumps, but may need a C-wire or an adapter kit. No Matter, Apple Home or Google Home support is stated.
caveats: May need a C-wire or a separately sold power adapter kit.
Not compatible with 110-240 V systems such as electric baseboard heat.
Apple Home, Google Home and Matter support are not stated.

sources.title: Does Amazon Smart Thermostat Work with My System? - Amazon Customer Service
